after.description: The promo code discount amount is not displayed as expected for return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. When a customer purchases a return trip ticket using a promo code, the discount amount shown in the email confirmation is incorrect or missing, while one-way trip tickets display the promo code amount correctly. This story fixes the promo code amount display for return trip tickets so that the discount amount and name appear correctly in the Mozio email confirmation.
after.title: Fix promo code amount display for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Bug: promo code discount amount is not displayed correctly for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The return-trip mapping path likely omits or incorrectly passes the discount amount when constructing the dispatch report. Review required a deliverable-style title and measurable ACs derived from the description since original ACs were empty.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria with only a descriptive note about the bug. All 8 ACs are new additions by speckit. AC-1 and AC-2 address the core bug: discount amount and name for return trips. AC-3 is a regression guard ensuring one-way trip behavior remains unchanged. AC-4 and AC-5 cover edge cases (no promo code, zero-value promo). AC-6 and AC-7 ensure the fix propagates through the dispatch report and webhook pipeline, informed by the technical notes listing map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts, apply-report-discounts.service.ts, and http-mozio-webhook.ts. AC-8 covers the scenario where outbound and return segments may carry different discount values, ensuring the mapping handles each segment independently.
